summary: ESG Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an October 15, 2026 Control Share Purchase and Transfer Agreement in which DCG China Limited, holder of 9,641,110 shares (~61.836% of common stock), will sell that control block to BevPoint Capital LP for $250,000 total — $125,000 cash at closing and a $125,000 six-month promissory note. The Company receives none of the proceeds. Closing is conditioned on expiration of the Rule 14f-1 period, a lender agreement, officer/director transition documentation, and no injunction; a Schedule 14F-1 will follow. Incumbents are expected to resign and Buyer designees appointed at closing, with a later business combination contemplated and possible Series A Control Preferred giving Buyer ≥90% voting power. Watch 14f-1 timing, note repayment, and dilution risk.
